opening: The caller reports a person who fell beside a loading bay and remains unresponsive. No movement has been observed; breathing is unconfirmed. There is blood nearby, but its source is unknown. This requires urgent medical and ambulance review. The site address and injury details are still missing.
question: Which site is the caller at?
followup: Do you have any information about injuries?
transcript: Someone fell down beside the loading bay and is not responding to me. I called out several times and did not see any movement. I cannot confirm whether the person is breathing. I can see a small patch of blood on the ground nearby, but I do not know where it came from. Another worker is waiting at the entrance. I do not know the address. Please help.
